_: Every standing rule of derekzhou.com as data. Each rule: id (kebab-case, unique), area, rule (what holds), source (the owner's words and date where known, the record it is kept in), enforced_by (kind ci-step: a step name in .github/workflows/*.yml; world-rule: a rule id world_rules.py fails under; absence: a numbered (N) block of the step 'Absences are enforced'; hook: a .claude/hooks file that cites the rule's id; permission-deny: an entry of .claude/settings.json's permissions.deny; prose: written down only, checked by people). CI ('The rules are data, and the hooks hold', rules_check.py) proves every reference exists.

rules.rule: The HTML has none of the internet's body language: no arrows, cookie or analytics vocabulary, Loading states or navigation roles.

No exit, idle, hover-position, key, blur, title, favicon-swap or storage handler in the JS; a pointer's moves are read only by the world's drag (its one pointermove listener added in onDown, removed in endDrag).
No innerHTML and no JS-generated DOM: the canvas, the stack, the footer and the lettered name are all in index.html.

No URL hook (location., URLSearchParams), sound, network call or eval; no worker but the plan's, started by its literal name; no cursor: rule (OS cursors only). The site's own code is blind: no telemetry, beacon or store (Cloudflare Web Analytics, injected by Cloudflare, is the one exception).

source.quote: yes we need analytics

rules.rule: The shipped scripts carry no development harness: no window.__*, window.claude or console call, and no attribute read on <html> but the hour's data-sky and data-sky-at.

CSP is set per HTML path with no overlapping rules (Cloudflare Pages combines same-named headers, and browsers enforce the intersection); never a Content-Security-Policy on /*. 404.html carries the same policy in a meta tag, kept in sync. Every home-scope CSP has exactly script-src 'self' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com and connect-src https://cloudflareinsights.com https://derekzhou.com/cdn-cgi/rum. No inline style, script or handler on a CSP'd page.

The scripts load in their order (hour, site.js, the world, the kits, the wing model, the ink birds), each tagged data-cfasync="false" for Rocket Loader; no script is async; the world, the kit and the realms are parser-blocking after the footer (the first-paint hold), the wing model and the ink birds deferred; the head holds one link rel=expect href=#world-end blocking=render, and the body one empty, hidden <div id="world-end"> right after the last realm's script (the render block ends there).
Nothing but the site is served: site/ holds only the kinds of file the site serves, the root only the repository's own; CLAUDE.md, .github/ and the font scripts stay outside the build.
Nothing built is committed: a change is made in src/ and committed alone, and the build (tools/build.mjs) makes the rest, the same bytes every time.

Everything but HTML is cached immutable, so changed bytes need a new name: the build names scripts and the stylesheet by content; fonts and images are renamed by hand, with every reference, in the same commit.

Every visit of a device compiles the same shader sources, and every program compiles; which programs a change edits is the gate's census of the base's and the head's builds, never a committed file (a returning visitor's shader cache depends on it).
The page says exactly its words: the lettered name, the one line, the credit row (Team Lead · Accenture Song · 2022 – Now) and the two links; the share and search text match.

rules.rule: Only code and assets under MIT, BSD, Apache, ISC, zlib, Unlicense or CC0 go into the site, plus CC BY for research data with credit given. Fonts must be licensed for the web (open-licensed like Geist's OFL, or a bought web licence); never unlicensed copies or a desktop font file.

Never name, in the repository, a commit or a PR: the reference game, its studio, a painter or any person (beyond the owner as the site's subject); never the removed side project. Banned names are kept as salted hashes in .claude/hooks/names.json, never written out. To add one: python3 .claude/hooks/add_names.py < a file of names outside the repo (it stores only their salted hashes).

rules.rule: Trusted Types stays off while Cloudflare Rocket Loader is on (it re-executes scripts through a TT sink); if Rocket Loader is ever disabled, re-add require-trusted-types-for 'script' to the three home-scope CSP blocks.

No name is declared twice in one scope of a served script: the world's and the ink birds' sections join into one scope, where a second function declaration (or a var of the same name in another section) silently replaces the first. tools/dup-names.mjs fails on a new one, naming both section files; a duplicate left to its lane goes in its KNOWN (none now: lateWarm was fixed by #70, inkbirds' BA renamed in the planner by #63).
